description: This file contains the implementation of the Zend_Json_Encoder class, which provides methods for encoding PHP data structures into JSON format, including handling objects, arrays, and basic data types. It also includes static methods for encoding PHP classes into JavaScript class2 format.

classes.name: Zend_Json_Encoder
classes.description: A class providing methods to encode PHP data structures into JSON format, including objects, arrays, and basic data types, as well as encoding PHP classes into JavaScript class2 format.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Static method to encode a PHP value into JSON, with optional cycle check.

methods.name: _encodeValue
methods.description: Recursively encodes a value based on its type (object, array, or datum).

methods.name: _encodeObject
methods.description: Encodes a PHP object into JSON, including its public properties and class name.

methods.name: _wasVisited
methods.description: Checks if an object has been visited during encoding to prevent cycles.

methods.name: _encodeArray
methods.description: Encodes a PHP array into JSON, handling associative and indexed arrays.

methods.name: _encodeDatum
methods.description: Encodes a basic data type (string, number, boolean, null) into JSON.

methods.name: _encodeString
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for JSON encoding.

methods.name: _encodeConstants
methods.description: Encodes the constants of a ReflectionClass into a JSON format.

methods.name: _encodeMethods
methods.description: Encodes the public methods of a ReflectionClass into a JavaScript class2 format.

methods.name: _encodeVariables
methods.description: Encodes the public properties of a ReflectionClass into a JavaScript class2 format.

methods.name: encodeClass
methods.description: Encodes a PHP class into JavaScript class2 format, including constants, methods, and variables.

methods.name: encodeClasses
methods.description: Encodes multiple PHP classes into JavaScript class2 format.
